proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _ I
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Submodule.IsLasker.exists_isMinimalPrimaryDecomposition (Submodule.isLasker R R) I
  refine ⟨t, ht.inf_eq, ht.primary, ?_, ht.minimal, ?_⟩
  · intro J hJ K hK hne
    have := ht.distinct hJ hK hne
    simpa only [Function.onFun, Submodule.colon_univ] using this
  · have h := ht.image_radical_eq_associated_primes
    simp only [Submodule.colon_univ] at h
    have h' : Submodule.associatedPrimes I = {P : Ideal R | P.IsPrime ∧ ∃ x : R, P = (Submodule.colon I {x}).radical} := by
      ext P
      exact Submodule.isAssociatedPrime_def
    exact h.trans h'
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R), ∃ t : Finset (Ideal R), t.inf id = I ∧ (∀ J ∈ t, J.IsPrimary) ∧ (t : Set (Ideal R)).Pairwise (fun J K => J.radical ≠ K.radical) ∧ (∀ J ∈ t, ¬ (t.erase J).inf id ≤ J) ∧ Ideal.radical '' (t : Set (Ideal R)) = {P : Ideal R | P.IsPrime ∧ ∃ x : R, P = (Submodule.colon I {x}).radical}
